## Session intent
Orchestrator session (23cb5219, /home/bewinxed/cockpit, hub on obelisk-of-light d04ca118428001f1, Mac Omars-MacBook-Pro 271a214a5d568e4c). Today's goals: previews working for the owner, ship nightly and TestFlight, harden the release pipeline, fix every bug found, and walk the owner through pending previews one by one ("let's go through what we need one by one").

Standing owner rules:
- "if there's an honest caveat that you are aware of and you're just reporting it to me instead of fixing it, then your work is not done yet".
- "I don't want the quick fix, I want the robust fix". No fallbacks, no unit tests, cutover with no shims, iOS parity.
- UI work goes advisor (Fable) → preview → owner pick → build, with interface-craft, Solar duotone icons, clean-copy, and no spend on everyday surfaces. A preview must be the real app with mock data only.
- Reuse existing components. The owner asked "why are you inventing new patterns" more than once.
- Release check: under 1 minute per check, trimmed not tuned. No old stage-2 wrappers. No history lines in config.
- Never use claude-in-chrome. Kill only your own PIDs. Web access is CRW plus Exa. Fleet config changes go only through admin_* tools.
- The owner pasted a sudo password in chat. It was used once for one command and never stored. He was told to rotate it.
- Nothing is filed upstream under the owner's account without his ask. The memory note is saved.
- Retire workspaces only through `POST /api/workspaces/<id>/archive` on the hub, never by deleting the folder.
- Delegates read only their own clone and scratch dir (`~/.cawco/tmp/<id>`). Briefs must push the branch or copy inputs into scratch. Host-wide work runs in a session started with `cwd ~/.config`.
- Don't list preview picks as "waiting on you" when the owner can't open them.
- The owner says some of my earlier status points "sound like stale stuff".

## Decisions made
Earlier decisions that still stand:
- **Firecrawl → CRW** at crw.bewinxed.com.
- **Hub-vouched previews** with `p-*.bewinxed.com` removed from the CF Access app "Outpost".
- **Release check rework:** 22 checks in 17 rigs. Wire guard uses git tags (`testflight-ios-<build>`). The `host` and `routineMade` bridges stay until TestFlight 20261015 expires.
- MachinePath, the Apple compile gate, and the formatting and typecheck tooling.

New this span:
- **Workspace retire.** Archive through the hub, never `rm`. The earlier by-hand `rm` produced stuck husks. A fleet CLAUDE.md edit says so, and a memory note is saved.
- **Preview serving.** Delegate-sandboxed servers die or strand at handovers. Previews for the owner now run as host systemd user units (`pv-*`). Panel artifacts point at host ports with `machine: obelisk-of-light`.
- **Preview mode.**
  - Switched to port at 18:50.
  - The iOS app then crashed on opening this chat; the owner confirmed closing the preview fixed it.
  - Reverted to host mode, pattern `https://p-{port}.bewinxed.com`.
  - The iOS crash is a separate bug; see next steps.
- **Boundary handover.** The root cause was not a nested pid namespace; the leaf rejected that. The preview broke at 16:46:26 when the hub's preview restart got WorkspaceDown during the keeper switch. Decided design (9a42147fb):
  - preview target = newest running generation listening on the port;
  - an older generation closes once a newer one serves all its work ports;
  - keepers are surveyed, and `KeepersUnanswered` is named;
  - `ownInodes` runs only with no older generation.
- **Report routing.** 190fa9fd8 and bb456dc95: reports and asks go only to the starting session, routine threads are excluded from newestConversation, `file` and other readers are ungated.
- **Caw settings** live in his lead session card (SessionDetails `kept`), reusing ModelSection. CawField, CawDock and CawPanel are deleted.
- **Routines.**
  - Bento from 1600px, view tabs below it.
  - One clock per row; detail doesn't repeat the row.
  - Instruction rendered as markdown; recent runs as a ledger table.
- **Task review.**
  - Advisor design adopted: the review is the session's message plus the artifact it presented.
  - No attempts or chips; "Sessions" in Details; Try again on failure.
  - The transcript is reached through Open ↗.
- **Decisions tab** is approved. The decided record is the settled cards.
- **OpenUI.**
  - Already in the PRD and built (custom views).
  - Approved: per-project mockup library generated from the project's `design/`, rendered in a shadow root. CawCo is one instance.
  - Steps 2 (task result kind `oui`) and 3 (`.oui` baked into decision pages) wait on the task review and Decisions tab landing.
- **Comments pane (per research).**
  - Pins stay on the preview.
  - A pin's thread opens as a ~200px popover.
  - Floating "Comments N" panel with Open/Resolved tabs.
  - Mode toolbar Interact (V) / Comment (C) / Draw (D); Esc returns to Interact; ⇧C hides pins.

  - Fetches answer at once and report via `fleet.fetch` frames.
  - Enable/disable is a separate PATCH.
  - Marketplace reads and links via new routes.
- **MCP.** The hub-side relay `FleetMcpRelay` owns the upstream rate (429s are never relayed); handshake params persist in the DB (migration 0173); sessions heal at attach and sync.
- **DB.** One rule for the hub DB and projects dir (`hubDbPath`); a hub refuses a DB another live hub holds; dev scripts default to `cawco-dev`.
- **Retire protection.** A workspace shown by a preview artifact isn't auto-retired. Archives carry git-ignored own files (64 MB bound).
- **Previews follow the dashboard's origin** (95bafd299): host-mode names only under the pattern's domain, else the session's own port.
